html:
SMTO-CTR-0009 — A check found the task plan refers to a file it wasn't given

GUID: 03f9f759-4bb6-4473-9512-788376b28ba0
Slug: task-contract-invalid-context-reference
Domain: CTR · Subsystem: task-contract

What happened

  • A separate check of a Task Contract (the plan SMTO writes from a request) found it names an attached file or item that wasn't part of that request. The check didn't run or change anything.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Check that the file the task should use is attached to the request, and attach it with Add context if it's missing. A plan may only refer to files that came with the request.
  2. Send the request again as a new message so SMTO writes a new Task Contract. Don't submit this plan again unchanged. An unchanged plan fails this check every time, while a new plan is built from the files actually attached.

What success looks like

  • The check passes for the new Task Contract, or the new task shows Task contract generated and starts working.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the name of the file you meant to use, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't treat a plan that failed this check as approved to run.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • An offline Task Contract check found an authoritative reference whose context_id is not in the supplied context manifest.

What this means

  • Offline validate_contract finds an authoritative reference whose context_id is absent from the supplied manifest. This condition is produced by an explicit offline contract diagnostic, not the current compiler acceptance gate. It reports only the named check and cannot authorize execution or prove complete semantic fidelity.

Why this can happen

  • Offline validate_contract finds an authoritative reference whose context_id is absent from the supplied manifest.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the exact referenced ID with the authoritative supplied manifest, without inventing source contents.

How to fix it

  • validate_contract found an authoritative_references entry whose context_id is absent from the manifest supplied to the check. Compare that context_id with the manifest, supply the intended source through the normal context flow, and regenerate or correct the reference; this offline diagnostic is not the compiler acceptance gate and cannot authorize execution.
  • Select the exact intended source through the supported context flow and inspect the contract reference.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The offline check receives matching authorized source references.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • This condition is produced by an explicit offline contract diagnostic, not the current compiler acceptance gate. It reports only the named check and cannot authorize execution or prove complete semantic fidelity.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
